description: Source code for generating TypeScript definitions, validators, and protocol metadata for Playwright channels based on protocol.yml. It processes protocol definitions, generates type schemas, and writes output files for use in Playwright's codebase.

methods.name: raise
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid types during inlineType processing.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: inlineType
methods.description: Recursively generates TypeScript and schema representations for a given type definition.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Generates TypeScript and schema code for object properties.

methods.name: objectType
methods.description: Creates TypeScript and schema code for object types.

methods.name: addScheme
methods.description: Adds a schema definition to the validator_ts array.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes content to a file if it differs from existing content, tracking changes.
